headline.purpose: Page h1 on the leaf (26px on reviewer lead).

code.purpose: Mono for article numbers, source lines and code-book badges.

shadows.name: hard-leaf

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one Next/submit action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 2px solid #1f2fb0; background: #1f2fb0; color: #fff; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #16227f; border-color: #16227f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f2fb0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Back and other supporting actions; inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 2px solid #1a1815; background: #fbfaf6; color: #1a1815; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #1a1815; color: #fbfaf6; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f2fb0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square white field with 2px ink border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field label { font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; color: #1a1815; } .ds-field input { font-family: Literata, Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #fff; border: 2px solid #1a1815; border-radius: 0; color: #1a1815; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f2fb0; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Index Tab
components.description: Rail tab; height grows with open items; chamfered upper-right corner.
components.css: .ds-tab { box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; width: 82px; height: 120px; padding: 10px 4px 10px 9px; background: #1d9f9a; color: #1a1815; border: 2px solid #1a1815; border-left: 0; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 12px) 0, 100% 12px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-tab:hover { width: 88px; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Tinted state label; always icon plus text.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 22px; padding: 1px 8px 1px 6px; color: #14602a; background: #e3f3e6; border: 2px solid currentColor; }

components.name: Code Badge
components.description: Mono code-book badge for article numbers.
components.css: .ds-badge { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; line-height: 22px; padding: 0 7px; background: #1a1815; color: #fff; }

components.name: Leaf with Board
components.description: Milk-white leaf, 2px ink border, hard shadow, on the hue board.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-board { background: #1d9f9a; padding: 18px 28px 0 0; } .ds-leaf { background: #fbfaf6; border: 2px solid #1a1815; border-bottom: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #1a1815; padding: 36px 48px; color: #1a1815; font-family: Literata, Georgia, serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 26px; } .ds-leaf h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Errata Slip
components.description: The single error voice: vermilion top rule, slight tilt.
components.css: .ds-errata { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: baseline; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbc7bd; border-top: 5px solid #c8281e; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; color: #b3201a; transform: rotate(-0.3deg); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #cbc7bd; max-width: 760px; } .ds-errata strong { background: #c8281e; color: #fff; padding: 1px 8px; font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }

narrative.overview: The workspace is a reference binder: a near-black spine, a rail of colored index tabs down the left edge, and a milk-white leaf sitting on a board that takes the open tab's hue. The rail is map, progress meter and navigation at once; tab height grows with the work still open. Density is calm and reading-first: bookish serif body, plain grotesque for heads and labels, mono for article numbers. Everything is square, ruled in 2px ink, and flat.
keyCharacteristics: Six full-strength section hues, one active at a time on the board; the rest live only on the rail.
Milk-white leaf with 2px ink border and one short hard shadow.
Square corners everywhere; circles only for radio marks and binder punch holes.
Vermilion reserved for errors, blockers and the errata slip.
Status is carried by tinted pill plus text, never color alone.

rules.name: The One Board Rule
rules.body: Only the open section's hue floods the board; other hues appear on rail tabs alone.

rules.name: The Vermilion Reserve Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks errors and errata only; never decoration or a section hue.

rules.name: The Action Apart Rule
rules.body: Buttons and links use Action Ultramarine, not a section hue.

rules.name: The Source Line Rule
rules.body: A citation is followed by its mono source line (article, page); the mono face means "verifiable".

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels stay sentence case; the only uppercase is short status stamps (DRAFT, errata flag).

rules.name: The One Hard Edge Rule
rules.body: Only the leaf and modal get the 4px hard shadow; cards and fields stay flat.

dos: Do print the source line (mono article, page, quote) under every citation.
Do label AI output with the yellow DRAFT/AI tag and keep humans signing.
Do keep every control at 44px or taller (34px only for sm).
Do pair status color with an icon and text.
Do use `--hue` for fills tied to the open section and Action Ultramarine for actions.
donts: Don't add gradients, glass, blur or soft shadows.
Don't round corners except radios and punch holes.
Don't use a section hue for errors or vermilion for navigation.
Don't use logos or government-like branding.
Don't express completeness as a safety or approval claim.
